I was a catastrophic insurance adjuster for many years. Insurance is not the scam you think it is. The insurance company is NOT greedy. I will explain how it works now. You will not like the truth, but you must understand the game in order to play.
Insurance rates have gone stupid because the US dollar isn’t worth anything. A 2 x 4 used to cost $3 or so…now they’re $10. The board is still the same board but because the dollar is worthless, it takes more dollars to buy the same value. The purpose of insurance is to pay for the repairs to your property from fire or a named peril. So when lumber, drywall and paint requires more dollars, your premiums rise to match.
Flood insurance is the scam. If you are in a government declared flood zone and you have a mortgage, it is federal law that you purchase flood insurance. So let’s say your house floods in a storm. The flood insurance will pay YOUR MORTGAGE COMPANY, not you!!  Youre paying for it but it’s just the government making sure their banker buddies get their money. Screw you and your damaged house.
